reason: A media playback plugin that embeds videos in the chat input area, supports common video sources, and provides playback controls and keyboard shortcuts.

summaries.zh: 将哔哩哔哩、YouTube、Vimeo 或直链视频嵌入聊天输入框区域，并提供播放控制与快捷键。
summaries.en: Embeds Bilibili, YouTube, Vimeo, or direct-link videos near the chat input and provides playback controls and keyboard shortcuts.

capabilities: Embeds and plays videos from Bilibili, YouTube, Vimeo, and direct MP4 links
Adds an in-page video player and vertical playback controls near the chat input
Provides keyboard shortcuts and hover-based pause or resume behavior
